description.narrative:
GFSIS är en ideell georgisk tankesmedja vars syfte är att förbättra samhällsstyrning och introducera policybaserat beslutsfattande genom forskning och analys, utbildning av beslutsfattare och utbildningsinsatser inom regionala och internationella strategifrågor. GFSIS arbetar med statstjänstemän, etniska och religiösa minoriteter, politiska partier, journalister och den georgiska ortodoxa kyrkan.
Insatsen är ett kärnstöd. Verksamheten har tre huvudinriktningar: utbildning och kompetensutveckling, forskning och analys samt informations- och påverkansarbete.
Verksamheten förväntas leda till förbättrad samhällsstyrning och policybaserat beslutsfattande samt till att stödja konfliktprevention och en fredlig utveckling i regionen.

Georgian Foundation for Strategic and International Studies (GFSIS) mission defined as not-for-profit think tank dedicated to improvement of good governance practises and introducing policy based decision making culture in Georgia through research and analyses, training of policy makers and policy analyses and public education about strategic issues - both domestic and international. GFSIS works with public servants, ethnic and religious minorities and other parts of the society, like political parties, journalists, Georgian orthodox church. The intervention is a core support to GFSIS. GFSIS work in three directions a) teaching and training, b) research and analysis and c) public outreach and awareness raising. The activities contribute to good governance practices and to introducing policy-based decision making culture. One of the objectives of the GFSIS is to support conflict prevention and peace building efforts in the region. Overall the contribution aims to contribute to common understanding of values and priorities that should guide Georgia towards its ambition towards European integration.
The aim of the intervention is to improve good governance practices and to introduce policy-based decision-making culture in Georgia.

sector.narrative: Public sector policy and administrative management

description.narrative:
The assessment is that the results are very well in line with the objectives of the intervention. However, it is noted that there were some delays in 2024.
Regarding clear and interesting results; for example, GFSIS has strengthened the capacity of hundreds of Georgians and equipped them with the tools and skills in order to enforce good governance. Another example is the organisation's work with national minorities and youth, where activities have resulted in information exchange, establishing of networks and collaboration.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
